{{Term/Store|Ancient Technology|Ancient Technologies|Series, BotW}} is a recurring element in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW}}<ref name="CaC 404"/> Ancient Technology goes unnamed in {{TotK}} and {{AoC}}.

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Ancient Technology was created by the [[Sheikah]] 10,000 years prior to the events of {{BotW}}. All forms of Ancient Technology are powered by [[Ancient Energy]], a fluid found in [[Hateno Village]], on [[Tumlea Heights]], and underneath [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. When it is active, Ancient Technology glows a pale blue or orange color. When [[Malice]] is infecting it, it glows a vibrant pink.<ref name="CaC 404"/>

Ancient Technology led to [[Hyrule Kingdom]] becoming considerably advanced during the [[Era of Prosperity]].<ref name="CaC 362"/><ref name="BotW Old Man"/><ref name="BotW Impa"/><ref name="BotW Kass"/> With the state of their Technology, the people of [[Hyrule]] decided to prepare for the return of [[Calamity Ganon]].<ref name="BotW Impa 2"/><ref name="BotW Kass 2"/> However, following Calamity Ganon's sealing, the [[King of Hyrule]] and the rest of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule|Royal Family]] felt threatened by the Sheikah, and so they were forced to abandon their Technology.<ref name="CaC 362"/><ref name="BotW Old Man 2"/><ref name="BotW Cado"/><ref name="CaC 368"/>

100 years ago, when a [[Fortune Teller]] foretold the resurrection of Calamity Ganon, [[King Rhoam]] ordered excavations in search of Ancient Technology.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam"/> As part of this endeavor, the [[Ancient Research Institute]] was founded to study Ancient Technology, an effort lead by [[Purah]] and [[Robbie]].<ref name="CaC 396"/> Since there were concerns about the use of the potentially dangerous Ancient Energy so close to Hyrule Castle and Purah's recklessness, [[Impa]] became a royal advisor to oversee the Institute's work.<ref name="CaC 374"/> [[Princess Zelda]] herself often researched Ancient Technology in her [[Princess Zelda's Study|Study]].<ref name="CaC 251"/> When Calamity Ganon did eventually return, he used his Malice to corrupt Hyrule Kingdom's defenses.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 2"/> This lead to the deaths of the [[Champion]]s and King Rhoam, while [[Link]] was mortally wounded while defending Zelda.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 3"/>

During the [[Great Calamity]], the Ancient Research Institute was destroyed, eventually becoming the [[Royal Ancient Lab Ruins]].<ref name="CaC 396"/> Two new laboratories were established by Purah and Robbie to continue their research. At the [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]], Purah has studied the [[Rune]]s of the [[Sheikah Slate]]. Meanwhile, Robbie has focused his research on creating [[Weapon]]s that are effective against [[Guardian]]s.<ref name="CaC 398"/> These locations require the [[Blue Flame]]s from [[Ancient Furnace]]s, a source of Ancient Energy, to power their [[Guidance Stone]].<ref name="BotW Purah"/>

====Sheikah Slate====
{{Main|Sheikah Slate}}
[[File:BotW Slated for Upgrades.png|thumb|left|250px|Link upgrading his Sheikah Slate]]
When Link wakes up in the [[Shrine of Resurrection]], he will find the Sheikah Slate located in a [[Sheikah Slate Pedestal]] nearby. He hears the voice of Princess Zelda, who tells him to take it and that it will help guide him on his journey.<ref name="BotW Princess Zelda"/> The Slate is able to interface with other pieces of Ancient Technology, such as [[Sheikah Slate Terminal]]s.<ref name="BotW Princess Zelda 2"/> This allows Link to activate the [[Travel Gate]]s on [[Ancient Shrine]]s, [[Sheikah Tower]]s, and [[Divine Beast]]s.<ref name="BotW Sheikah Slate Terminal"/>

The primary function of the Sheikah Slate is its [[Rune]]s. On the [[Great Plateau]], Link can acquire several Runes for his Sheikah Slate. These are the [[Remote Bomb]]s, [[Magnesis]], [[Stasis]], and [[Cryonis]], which are distilled from Guidance Stones.<ref name="BotW Guidance Stone"/> At the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab, Purah can use her own Guidance Stone to restore the [[Camera]] Rune, in addition to unlocking the [[Album]] and the [[Hyrule Compendium]].<ref name="BotW Purah"/><ref name="BotW Guidance Stone 2"/> If [[amiibo]] compatibility is turned on in the [[System]] menu, the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] Rune will appear in the Sheikah Slate. Finally, during {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack, Link will obtain the [[Master Cycle Zero]] Rune after completing the [[Final Trial]].

====Structures====
{{Main|Ancient Shrine, Sheikah Tower, Shrine of Resurrection}}
A multitude of advanced Sheikah structures in Hyrule were constructed with the use of Ancient Technology. Following the banishment such Technology, these buildings have been dormant underground. Unlike other pieces of Ancient Technology, they have remained untouched by Calamity Ganon, though they are all initially in inactive states.<ref name="CaC 404"/>

[[File:BotW Slumber of Restoration.png|thumb|right|250px|Link waking up in the Shrine of Resurrection]]
One such building is the Shrine of Resurrection, a medical facility with the power to induce a long-term stasis in its patients.<ref name="BotW Zelda's Research Notes"/> Following his collapse during the Great Calamity, Link was taken to the Shrine to recover in a [[Slumber of Restoration]], eventually culminating in his awakening 100 years later.<ref name="BotW Princess Zelda 3"/><ref name="BotW King Rhoam 4"/> During the "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]" [[Main Quest]], which is exclusive to {{TCB|-}} Downloadable Content pack, the Shrine of Resurrection serves as the entrance to the Final Trial.<ref name="BotW Monk Maz Koshia"/><ref name="BotW Monk Maz Koshia 2"/>

[[Sheikah Tower]]s are another type of structure made with Ancient Technology. They are all initially buried beneath the ground, save for the top of the [[Great Plateau Tower]]. Once Link activates the Tower's Sheikah Slate Pedestal, it and all other Sheikah Towers will rise from the ground.<ref name="CaC 216"/><ref name="BotW Old Man 3"/> After a Sheikah Tower has been activated, its Guidance Stone will distill information for Link's [[Map]].<ref name="BotW Guidance Stone 3"/><ref name="BotW Guidance Stone 4"/>

The most common structures made from Ancient Technology are the Ancient Shrines. A total of 120 Ancient Shrines can be found throughout Hyrule, with 16 more being added in {{TCB|-}} Downloadable Content pack. They were designed by Sheikah [[Monk]]s to train the hero who would one day fight Calamity Ganon.<ref name="BotW Monk"/><ref name="BotW Monk 2"/><ref name="BotW Monk 3"/><ref name="BotW Zelda's Research Notes 2"/> Following the activation of the Sheikah Towers, all Ancient Shrines will begin to glow orange.<ref name="BotW Old Man 4"/> At the end of these Shriness, a Monk will award Link a [[Spirit Orb]].<ref name="BotW Monk 4"/><ref name="BotW Monk 5"/>

[[File:BotW Astral Observatory.png|thumb|left|250px|Link in the Astral Observatory]]
Hyrule Castle features several structures made using Ancient Technology. The five [[Giant Column]]s surrounding the Castle were made to store [[Guardian]]s, only emerging from the ground once they sensed the revival of Calamity Ganon.<ref name="BotW Zelda's Research Notes 3"/> Unlike other structures, they have been corrupted by Calamity Ganon's Malice, now glowing pink.<ref name="CaC 235"/> The same is true of the [[Astral Observatory]], which is located beneath the [[Sanctum]] and was once used by the Sheikah to study celestial bodies.<ref name="CaC 255"/> When Link confronts Calamity Ganon, the pair will fall through the floor of the [[Throne Room]] and into the Astral Observatory, where they will proceed to fight.

====Enemies====
{{Main|Guardian}}
10,000 years ago, the Guardians were created to protect Hyrule during the Great Calamity.<ref name="BotW Impa 3"/><ref name="BotW Kass 3"/> During the battle against Calamity Ganon, the Guardians defended the [[Ancient Hero]] of the time.<ref name="BotW Impa 4"/><ref name="BotW Kass 4"/> However, along with other forms of Ancient Technology, they were buried when the Sheikah were cast out.<ref name="CaC 362"/>

The Guardians were rediscovered during King Rhoam's excavations.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 5"/> However, Calamity Ganon ended up corrupting them and using them against Hyrule upon his return.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 2"/> 100 years later, many Guardians are still under the effects of Malice, and they will attack anyone who draws near. The only exception are the [[Guardian Scout]]s found in Ancient Shrines.

====Divine Beasts====
{{Main|Divine Beast}}
[[File:BotW Divine Beast Vah Naboris Excavation.png|thumb|right|250px|The excavation of Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]
The main defense against Calamity Ganon were the four Divine Beasts. They are known as [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]], [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]], [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]], and [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]. The Divine Beasts were built prior to the first Great Calamity 10,000 years ago.<ref name="BotW Impa 5"/><ref name="BotW Kass 5"/> Four Champions were selected to pilot the Divine Beasts during the battle.<ref name="BotW Impa 6"/><ref name="BotW Kass 6"/> When Calamity Ganon returned, the Divine Beasts unleashed their attacks upon him.<ref name="BotW Impa 4"/><ref name="BotW Kass 7"/> As with other pieces of Ancient Technology, they were buried following the splintering of the Sheikah.<ref name="CaC 362"/>

100 years ago, secret records kept by the Sheikah were able to guide King Rhoam's excavations to [[Gerudo Canyon]] and [[Zora's Domain]], where Divine Beast Vah Naboris and Divine Beast Vah Ruta were found respectively. Further excavations revealed Divine Beast Vah Rudania within [[Death Mountain]] and Divine Beast Vah Medoh near [[Rito Village]].<ref name="CaC 375"/><ref name="BotW Daruk's Training Journal"/> Four Champions were again chosen to pilot the Divine Beast.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 6"/> These Champions were [[Mipha]], [[Daruk]], [[Revali]], and [[Urbosa]]. At the moment of Calamity Ganon's return, the Champions were not with their Divine Beasts, allowing them to become quickly corrupted by his Malice while they were away.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 2"/> When they finally made it back, they would be greeted by the [[Blight Ganon]]s, which would eventually lead to their deaths.<ref name="BotW King Rhoam 3"/><ref name="CaC 383"/>

During his journey, Link will be given the Main Quest "[[Free the Divine Beasts]]", which tasks him with purging the Malice that has infected the Divine Beasts.<ref name="BotW Impa 7"/> If Link frees a Divine Beast, its pilot will aid him during his battle against Calamity Ganon.<ref name="BotW Revali"/><ref name="BotW Mipha"/><ref name="BotW Daruk"/><ref name="BotW Urbosa"/>

====Weapons and Armor====
{{Main|Ancient Set, Ancient Soldier Gear, Guardian Gear}}
The [[Weapon]]s made with Ancient Technology, known as [[Guardian Gear]], are effective for use against Guardians. They are most commonly wielded by Guardian Scouts, who can be found in Ancient Shrines and Divine Beasts. As part of his research, Robbie has developed new Weapons and [[Armor]] using Ancient Technology. These are the [[Ancient Set]] and the [[Ancient Soldier Gear]]. They can be forged with the [[Ancient Oven]], his modified Guidance Stone.<ref name="BotW Robbie"/>

Though not made of Ancient Technology themselves, many Weapons and pieces of Armor are made using Ancient Technology. For example, the [[Stealth Set]] utilizes noise-suppressing fabrics, which are known to be made Ancient Technology.<ref name="BotW Inventory"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 2"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 3"/> Weapons from the [[Royal Guard's Series]] were forged 100 years ago using Ancient Technology, and they were designed to arm the [[Royal Guard]] for the impending Great Calamity.<ref name="BotW Inventory 4"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 5"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 6"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 7"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 8"/> Finally, several pieces of modern [[Sheikah Gear]] were made with Ancient Technology.<ref name="BotW Inventory 9"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 10"/><ref name="BotW Inventory 11"/>

====Materials====
{{Main|Ancient Material}}
[[Ancient Material]]s are a type of [[Material]] dropped by Guardians upon their defeat. They are also common rewards from [[Treasure Chest]]s throughout Hyrule}. They can be used to enhance pieces of Armor at [[Great Fairy Fountain]]s, forge Ancient Soldier Gear,<ref name="BotW Robbie"/> and upgrade the Sheikah Slate's Runes.<ref name="BotW Purah 2"/>

==={{TotK|-}}===
[[File:TotK Ancient Technology 2.png|thumb|right|320px|alt= Link surrounded by Guardian limbs.|Link and the Ancient Technology in the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower from {{TotK|-}}]]
In the time between {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, all of the Ancient Technology turned to dust and disappeared. The only remnants are the replicas created by [[Purah]] in the modern day.<ref name="Zelda Notes"/> These replicas include the [[Purah Pad]], which is similar to the Sheikah Slate, as well as the technology used inside [[Skyview Tower]]s.
